\section*{Criterion}
A cell is a \emph{constant predictor} (collapsed) when
$\mathrm{ACC} \le \mathrm{floor} + 0.01$, where \emph{floor} is the
majority-class share of the test set that the cell was actually evaluated on.
The floor is bound per result json through
\texttt{aggregate.partition\_fingerprints} $\rightarrow$
\texttt{partition\_cache/v2/\textless DS\textgreater/\textless fp\textgreater/metadata.json} $\rightarrow$ per-client
\texttt{test\_stats.label\_counts}. The criterion is the one fixed by
\texttt{reported\_results/collapse\_audit/appendix\_collapse\_disclosure.md}~\S2.
Cell key is \texttt{dataset/split/algo/hyp/K}; when both hosts hold a copy the
newest \texttt{recorded\_at} wins (\S9.7). Main calibre means the algorithms
reaching \texttt{nsp\_max} partitions in that group, with ablation/sweep
variants and foreign algorithms excluded.

\section*{T8\quad Structural defects that block publication}

D1 & dataset-level collapse & 9 of 15 datasets are wholly or nearly wholly collapsed; UTKFace and FairFace have EVERY algorithm below the floor, i.e. the failure is in the label/partition/evaluator, not in any algorithm. & ADULT 100\%, DRUG 100\%, FairFace 100\%, UTKFace 100\%, CREMA-D 96\%, CREMA-D\_gender 94\%, RAVDESS 94\%, BANK 87\%, LFWA+ 82\% & ADULT and DRUG must be removed from the main table (appendix S7). UTKFace / FairFace / LFWA+ / CREMA-D* / RAVDESS produce no usable number for any algorithm. \\
D2 & baseline is a no-op & FairFed reproduces FedAvg bit-for-bit, so the FairFed column carries no information about FairFed. & 33 (dataset, K, split) cells identical on ACC+ACC\_gap+DEO: ADULT/K20/Dirichlet01, ADULT/K20/Dirichlet05, ADULT/K20/Dirichlet1, ADULT/K20/Uniform, BANK/K20/Dirichlet05, BANK/K20/Uniform, BANK/K30/Dirichlet01, BANK/K30/Dirichlet05 & FairFed cannot be used as a comparison point on those datasets until the implementation is fixed. \\
D3 & baseline is a no-op & mFairFL reproduces FedAvg bit-for-bit on some datasets. & 5 cells identical: ADULT/K20/Dirichlet01, ADULT/K20/Dirichlet05, ADULT/K4/Dirichlet05, CREMA-D/K20/Dirichlet1, RAVDESS/K20/Speaker & Same as D2 for mFairFL. \\
D4 & hyper-parameter not wired & FedRenyi lambda has no effect: lam0p25 / lam0p5 / lam1 / lam2 give identical numbers on DRUG. & 4 variant dirs, identical ACC/ACC\_gap/DEO on DRUG & The Renyi fairness-strength ablation cannot be reported. \\
D5 & result-tree pollution & COMPAS and DRUG 20Clients directories mix PDFFed ablation variants and lambda sweeps with the main comparison, at nsp=1-2 only. & COMPAS K=20 holds 76 distinct algorithm directories & Any ranking that does not filter these is meaningless; they are excluded here by the ABLATION regex. \\
D6 & coverage hole & CelebA has no PDFFed (non-DP) and no LoGoFair result at all; UTKFace K=30/40 has no PDFFed-family result. & CelebA main algorithms present: FL\_FairBatch, FairFed, FedAvg, FedFair, FedNova, FedProto, FedProx, FedRenyi, FederatedAverageWithPo, PDFFed\_DP, Scaffold, mFairFL | UTKFace algorithms present: FL\_FairBatch, FairFed, FedAvg, FedFair, FedNova, FedProto, FedProx, FederatedAverageWithPo, PDFFed\_DP\_eps1, PDFFed\_DP\_eps100, PDFFed\_DP\_eps1000, PDFFed\_DP\_eps1e+06, PDFFed\_DP\_eps20, PDFFed\_DP\_eps50, PDFFed\_DP\_eps8, Scaffold & CelebA can only support a PDFFed\_DP claim, and only 3 algorithms reach nsp=4 there, so the group is too thin to rank. \\
D7 & foreign algorithms & .31 result tree contains algorithms belonging to another project, some without ACC\_gap/HM at all. & DOSFL, FedFACT, FedMix, NaiveMix, OSFL, PraFFL, ProxProbability & They show up as NaN rows and must be filtered before any ranking. \\
D8 & provenance & Cells whose json is missing or whose partition fingerprint is not in the local cache cannot be assigned a floor or a commit. & 97 cells: ADULT=5, COMPAS=33, CelebA=2, DRUG=24, DUTCH=24, LFWA+=2, moji=7 & They are excluded from every collapse statistic and cannot enter a single-commit table. \\
D9 & reproducibility & The same cell key run on two machines / two commits disagrees on ACC. & 94 cells disagree, max spread 0.3990 (BANK/Uniform/FedProx/ANN/30) & Fix per appendix S9.1: publish from ONE commit, do not re-run. Selection rule fixed a priori to newest recorded\_at. \\
D10 & metric interpretation & PDFFed wins HM/ACC but ranks mid-to-low on ACC\_gap and DEO in the same groups, so the HM win is driven by accuracy, not by narrowing unfairness. & see pdffed\_head\_to\_head.csv columns gap\_rank / deo\_rank & Any claim of a fairness advantage must be made on CelebA PDFFed\_DP only (DEO rank 1), and must not be inferred from HM. \\
D11 & mitigation did not help & balance\_sampling=1 was turned on for 20 cells (0 in the 2026-10-21 audit) but every one of them is still collapsed. & 20 cells, all on RAVDESS (floor 0.8667) and CREMA-D\_gender (floor 0.8293) & Label-balanced sampling does not rescue high-floor datasets; the collapse cause is elsewhere. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
\endgroup

\section*{Bottom line}
Under the floor criterion only \textbf{DUTCH, COMPAS, AudioMNIST, CelebA
(PDFFed\_DP only) and BANK (with mandatory disclosure)} can enter the main
result table.

\begin{enumerate}
\item PDFFed (non-DP) does rank first, but it wins on accuracy, not on
fairness: of its 10 main-calibre groups it takes HM rank 1 in 9 and
ACC rank 1 in 8,
while \texttt{gap\_rank} and \texttt{deo\_rank} sit mid-to-low in the same
groups (COMPAS DEO 13/16, DUTCH ACC\_gap 10/15). The largest genuine margin is
DUTCH ($\Delta$HM $+0.11\ldots+0.15$ over FedAvg, $+0.071$ over the strongest
baseline mFairFL), then AudioMNIST ($+0.025$ over Po).
\item CelebA PDFFed\_DP is the only combination that is simultaneously DEO rank
1 and HM rank 1 (DEO $0.018/0.013$ vs FedAvg $0.253/0.306$), at the cost of
$3.7$--$10.4$pp of accuracy; only 3 algorithms reach nsp=4 there, so the group
is too thin to support a ranking claim.
\item The BANK margin is at noise scale: floor $0.8776$, PDFFed exceeds it by
only $+1.19$ to $+1.46$pp on average ($n_{\text{test}}=13211$, so 1pp
$\approx132$ samples) and 1--2 of its 4 partitions are still collapsed. Per
\S7 the crossing results may be kept only alongside the disclosure that the
other 13 algorithms stay $\le+1.02$pp with 10 of them never crossing.
\item Five modalities currently yield nothing usable: text (bios), faces
(UTKFace / FairFace / LFWA+) and speech emotion (CREMA-D / CREMA-D\_gender /
RAVDESS). bios floor is $0.5449$; PDFFed\_DP $0.520$ and PDFFed $0.485$ are
both \emph{below} it, i.e. both are collapsed cells, and their small ACC\_gap
is spurious fairness from constant prediction.
\item ADULT and DRUG leave the main table entirely (100\% collapsed, zero
crossing cells) per \S7.
\item Publication route: do not re-run; publish from a single commit
(\texttt{e4f45401b} for BANK/DRUG/COMPAS/DUTCH, \texttt{e34c32ad3} for ADULT),
selecting the newest \texttt{recorded\_at} per cell. Cross-host disagreements
are enumerated in Table~\ref{tab:cross_machine_disagreement}.
\end{enumerate}
